get.description: The original bytes, with Range support for PDF.js. Quarantined files are never served.
A deliberate step (DEC-59): shows what was hidden in the file, and records that it was viewed.
Text blocks with their boxes, page by page: the viewer for DOCX, email and text files, and in-document search.
The current version, or an older one for version history.

patch.description:
Lawyer edits (a new version), restoring a version, accepting a preview, safeguards switches, checklist
acknowledgements, set-aside claims and named sources. `base_version` must be the version you loaded, or the
edit is refused with 409 version_conflict. A change to the text or the safeguards after adoption returns the
draft to "not reviewed" (DEC-51).

get.description: Point-by-point check (DEC-47), the citation checklist (DEC-49) and what still blocks a clean export.

post.description:
A new section answering a point the draft doesn't answer yet (DEC-47), as a preview. Accepted with PATCH
`accept_proposal`, which adds it before the closing.
Clean: what you send, blocked until it is safe (DEC-50). Working copy: with sources, stamped privileged.

Marks the draft "Reviewed and adopted" and records when (DEC-51). Removes the watermark. Refused with 409
review_blocked while placeholders, unanswered points or unacknowledged citations remain.

A rewrite of one section as a preview with its diff (decision 3). Nothing changes until PATCH sends
`accept_proposal`; a preview made before another change is refused with 409 proposal_stale.
Regenerates one section as a background job; the result is a new version with a diff (DEC-44).
A queued job is cancelled at once; a running one stops at its next step.

get.description: The file a finished export job produced (the matter .zip, DEC-33).

post.description: Makes the matter read-only (DEC-32). Closing an already closed matter is a no-op.

get.description: Pinned chats first, then newest first.

post.description:
Starts a draft without a chat turn, e.g. from "Draft a reply…" on a document (decision 4). The draft is
written as a background job; follow it on the matter's event stream.

get.description:
job.progress, job.done, job.failed, document.ready, document.failed and conversation.updated.

Without Last-Event-ID (or ?since=) the stream starts from now; with it, missed events are replayed.

post.description:
Queues the full matter file as a .zip (DEC-33); download it from GET /jobs/{job_id}/file when done.
Allowed on closed matters too: that is when the client's file is usually returned.

get.description: The matter's summaries, newest first; `document_id` narrows it to one document (INT-1.3).

post.description: Helpful, wrong citation, missed something, should have said not found (DEC-52). Resending replaces it.
The Stop button. The run ends with `done {cancelled: true}`; stopping a finished run changes nothing.

get.description: SSE for one turn: run.started → intent → scope → status… → token… → citation… → answer_state → done.

post.description:
The summary as a .docx working copy with its sources, stamped privileged (decision 5). Summaries are for
the lawyer's file, so there is no clean copy.
